name: BB's Health Foods
description: We're the leading health food store in southern Baldwin County. At BB's, we will do our very best to offer the highest quality, and focus on offering only clean products with clean ingredients from companies with integrity. Our extensive selection of products varies from supplements and herbal remedies to natural health and beauty aids. We are the perfect destination for those with food allergies and sensitivities, as we have a variety of gluten free and sugar free products and so much more. We also offer a unique and wide-range of bulk herbs. People who are seeking alternative choices for diabetes, menopause relief, weight loss, gastrointestinal problems and multiple other medical issues can find solutions and remedies offered by BB's knowledgeable and experienced staff. There are many alternative treatment methods for every condition and we will strive to provide quality, educational resources, and support.
